# Chicken Addis

> Ethiopia's hands-on poultry school on the Addis Ababa–Bishoftu belt. 123 rounds taught, 2.4k farmers graduated, 18k eggs graded daily. Training in Amharic.

## Training

- [Beginner's Foundation — Shelter, Feed & Hygiene](https://mychickenaddis.com/#training): 21-day hands-on course for first-time farmers. Shelter building, feed mixing, chick handling.
- [Scale-Up Mastery — Layers, Yields & Flock Health](https://mychickenaddis.com/#training): for working farms with 50+ birds. Layers, yields, costing.
- [Breeders' Camp — Cross-Breeds & Hatchery Craft](https://mychickenaddis.com/#training): Round 124, coming soon. Cross-breeds and hatchery craft.

## Services

- [Egg Production](https://mychickenaddis.com/#services): daily graded egg supply for Addis Ababa and Bishoftu buyers.
- [Cages & Equipment](https://mychickenaddis.com/#services): modern housing, feeders, drinkers and ventilation, demo yard on site.
- [Poultry Finance](https://mychickenaddis.com/#services): costing, pricing and startup-loan advisory with a loan-ready business plan.

## Practices

- [Our five practices](https://mychickenaddis.com/#experiences): training, finance, eggs, equipment and community. One round covers all five.

## Community

- [Our Story](https://mychickenaddis.com/#community): from a backyard coop to classrooms and supply lines serving hundreds of graduates. Daily Amharic videos on breeds, layers and chick care.

## FAQ

- [Choosing the right course or coop](https://mychickenaddis.com/#faq): which course suits beginners, families, youth groups; 24 farmers per round, monthly rounds.

## Enquire

- [Plan your visit / request a call back](https://mychickenaddis.com/#enquire): Bishoftu Road, Addis Ababa. Open yard daily 8:00–17:00. hello@chickenaddis.et. Reply on Telegram within one working day.
